pages.text: $(italic)Resource investment. Best for Artificer, Halfling builds, or any player focused on automation setup.$(/italic)$(br2)Mining speed and luck are attribute-based and apply immediately. Crop yield bonus and fishing luck require KubeJS event hooks (implemented in Phase 1).

pages.title: Nodes
pages.text: $(bold)Mining Speed$(/bold) — apothic_attributes:mining_speed — percentage bonus to all block-breaking speed.$(br2)$(bold)Fortune Enhancement$(/bold) — Increases effective Fortune level for loot table rolls. Does not add enchant levels — it adds luck to the roll.$(br2)$(bold)Crop Yield$(/bold) — KubeJS harvest event: chance for bonus crop drops. Scales linearly to +50% at max investment.

pages.title: Nodes (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Prospector Branch$(/bold) — Vein mining-style bonuses: detecting ore proximity, bonus drops from ore processing.$(br2)$(bold)Naturalist Branch$(/bold) — Fishing speed, bait efficiency, mob loot quantity bonuses.$(br2)$(bold)Gathering Capstone$(/bold) — $(bold)Master Gatherer$(/bold) — All resource gathering has 10% chance to trigger double yield. Stacks with Fortune.
